Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE independent production 2D world-map island, restored state, genuinely transparent background.
Image 1 is the official Frostfruit Orchard level painting: use its orchard identity, spreading opal tree, snow, hanging glass-bell fruit, pale stone terraces, tending trays and resting bench. Image 2 is the accepted standalone Lantern island and Image 3 the accepted Ribbon island: match their elevated orthographic three-quarter camera, warm upper-left light, pearl/brass/violet storybook miniature materials, crisp complete silhouette and degree of detail. These are references only. Do not reproduce a full screen or the empty starfield in Image 1.
Create one cohesive, substantial floating winter orchard island on a square transparent canvas, ideally 1254x1254 to match the existing map family. Same source composition scale and camera as Image 2, with the entire island inside the canvas and clear transparent padding around every branch, glow and crystal. No perspective convergence, no horizon. Preserve a richly crafted connected place, recognizable when displayed at 220–270 points wide.
Subject: Frostfruit Orchard. One spreading irregular opal-barked tree with a broad frosted blue-white crown rises from a snowy moonstone terrace. Five or six large hanging glass-bell fruits are the main identity: translucent blue-lilac bells around warm pearl-gold seed hearts. The high central fruit cluster is visibly OPEN, its glass lobes separated around a luminous heart. This final opening must be distinct in silhouette, not merely brighter. Preserve winter snow and cool foliage, with warm fine veins in bark and lit brass lanterns. A stone path joins a curved bench tucked between roots, a shallow collecting tray and one small seed basket. Add a few thick supported stone steps and blue crystal roots under the floating terrain. Use bold connected forms and restrained small details; no loose separate props.
Keep the front-center path at normalized (.50,.68) visually quiet and open for a separate native map pin. The path ends at the island's own intact front edge; no outgoing bridge, stair fragment or neighboring terrain. All scene elements belong to this one complete island cutout.
No sky, background, clouds, stars outside the island, ground plane, ground shadow, people, names, typography, UI, icons, labels or native selector. Real alpha, no painted checkerboard. No cropping of tree crown, branches, glass fruit, terrain or hanging crystals.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: dormant, unrepaired variant of the supplied transparent Frostfruit Orchard map island.
Edit target: the supplied single restored orchard island. Preserve EXACTLY its 1254x1254 square canvas, elevated orthographic camera, island scale, complete outer tree-and-terrain silhouette, trunk and branch positions, stone terrace and steps, bench, collecting trays, front-center clear path, transparent margins and crystal-root shapes. This is a registered game-state variant, not a new composition: no rotation, no recentering, no resizing, no additions outside the silhouette.
Change only repair state. The hanging glass-bell fruit is opaque frosted blue-white glass with no glowing heart; close the central opened cluster into one sealed bell-shaped fruit within its current central footprint. Keep that same cluster's location and stem, but visibly remove the open petal gaps. Thick frost holds the luminous seeds quiet inside the fruit. The tree's warm branching veins and small brass lanterns are unlit. Collected seeds in the existing trays and basket are opaque, pale and dormant. Hanging crystal roots keep their same shapes but lose their emission.
Winter remains beautiful and intact: retain clean soft blue-white snow, frosted leaves, opal bark and the substantial crafted terrace. Do not make the snow dirty or turn the place into ruins. Use cooler gently subdued pearl/lilac materials, tarnished brass and restrained wear while maintaining the same high-quality readable miniature rendering. No global fog or uniform gray overlay.
No sky, clouds, detached stars, background, opaque matte, floor or shadow plane, neighboring islands, UI, text, labels, markers, people or painted checkerboard. Preserve real transparency and all major object registration. Do not alter the front path where the app places its separate native pin.
